act.name: Hindu Succession Act, 1956
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing intestate succession, coparcenary rights and inheritance among Hindus.

sections.title: Devolution of interest in coparcenary property.
sections.text: Section 6 governs devolution of coparcenary interests and recognizes a daughter's coparcenary rights by birth.
sections.plain_language_summary: Daughters have coparcenary rights by birth in the same manner as sons, subject to the Act.

sections.title: General rules of succession in the case of males.
sections.text: Section 8 sets out the general order of intestate succession to the property of a male Hindu.
sections.plain_language_summary: Explains who inherits when a Hindu man dies without a will.

sections.title: General rules of succession in the case of female Hindus.
sections.text: Section 15 sets out the general order of intestate succession to the property of a female Hindu.
sections.plain_language_summary: Explains who inherits when a Hindu woman dies without a will.
